name: RIS Cloudflare CAPTCHA
author: Md Taufiqur Rahman

sections.description:
RIS Cloudflare CAPTCHA is a simple yet powerful plugin that integrates Cloudflare’s CAPTCHA (Turnstile) into your WordPress site. By default, it adds CAPTCHA to your login page to protect against brute-force attacks. Additionally, you can enable CAPTCHA on all forms across your site, including the comment section, to prevent spam and other malicious activities.

Key Features:

  • Add Cloudflare CAPTCHA to the WordPress login page.
  • Optionally enable CAPTCHA on all forms, including comment forms.
  • Simple configuration through the WordPress admin panel.
  • Protects against spam, bots, and other automated abuse.

Important Note:
This plugin relies on Cloudflare’s servers to verify CAPTCHA responses, and verification requests are securely sent to Cloudflare. No data is stored or transmitted beyond this verification.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the ris-cloudflare-captcha folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ‘RIS Cloudflare CAPTCHA’ settings page in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your Cloudflare Site Key and Secret Key.
  5. Optionally, enable CAPTCHA on all forms, including the comment form, by ticking the checkbox.
sections.faq:
Where can I get the Cloudflare Site Key and Secret Key?

You can obtain the Cloudflare Site Key and Secret Key by registering your site on Cloudflare’s Turnstile service. Visit Cloudflare’s Turnstile for more information.

Does this plugin support other CAPTCHA providers?

No, this plugin is specifically designed for Cloudflare’s CAPTCHA (Turnstile).

Can I disable CAPTCHA on specific forms?

As of version 1.0, the CAPTCHA can be enabled or disabled globally on all forms. Selective form control is planned for future releases.
